name: sms-spam-tfidf-logistic-regression

dataset.dataset_name: UCI SMS Spam Collection (web-exported mirror copy)
dataset.version: 2011 collection; 2026-11-21 web-export copy identified by SHA-256
dataset.attribution: Almeida, T. & Hidalgo, J. (2011). SMS Spam Collection. UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI: 10.24432/C5CC84.
dataset.acquisition_method: Connected web tool exported all 5579 displayed source lines; shell DNS prevented original ZIP download.

label_definitions.spam: spam; not a verified fraud label

acquisition_transformations: Rejoin five unlabelled source continuation lines into preceding records
Serialize real labeled records as UTF-8 JSONL
limitations: Historical general SMS spam/ham task, not Indian banking fraud
Mirror was accessed at a mutable main URL; the export is frozen by checksum
Web export may normalize source whitespace/control characters; it is not byte-identical to the original
No live-threat status for URLs appearing in the corpus
No externally verified multilingual or current Indian fraud evaluation

split.method: StratifiedGroupKFold 5-way outer test fold and 4-way inner validation fold; first folds fixed in advance
split.grouping: exact normalized text template after replacing URLs and digit sequences
split.test_usage: Untouched holdout; evaluated once after a fixed baseline fit; no tuning or final refit

limitations: Historical general SMS spam/ham classification; spam is not equivalent to fraud.
Not evaluated on Indian banking fraud, current scams, Hindi or other Indian languages.
Group-separated random holdout is not a chronological or independent external test set.
Exact URL/number template grouping mitigates, but does not eliminate, near-duplicate campaign leakage.
Decision-function values are uncalibrated margins, not fraud probabilities or confidence.
